data.name: Corbett
data.gender_notes: Corbett is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Gaelic word ‘gorbet’, meaning ‘suppler’ or ‘dexterous’. In Scotland, it was a nickname for someone who was skilled with a spear or javelin. In Ireland, it was a surname for someone who lived near a forest or a corbeau (raven). The name Corbett carries the meaning “Bravery, Dexterity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Corbett usually hope their child will grow to embody bravery, dexterity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Corbett total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
